input: I thought students needed a study-group app. In this synthetic scenario, we asked six classmates about last week: five had already arranged study through their existing group chat without trouble; one struggled. Nobody agreed to try our prototype. What should we do?
output:

This is synthetic roleplay evidence, not real fieldwork.

Zero commitments to try the prototype, even hypothetically, is also a signal worth taking seriously rather than explaining away.

None of this means the idea is dead — it means the target problem may be narrower or different than first assumed.
